name: io.github.MohdSaleh/tinyfish-guided-research
title: TinyFish Guided Research
description: Auditable deep-research MCP server powered by TinyFish Search and Fetch.

environmentVariables.name: TINYFISH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TinyFish API key used by Search and Fetch.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Shared PostgreSQL connection URL for durable production state. Recommended for remote/multi-replica hosting.

environmentVariables.name: RESEARCH_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: SQLite persistence path used when DATABASE_URL is unset. Intended for local/single-instance usage.
